name: distributed-agent-set
body: The agents `apg init` installs into `~/.opencode/agents/` from `opencode-suite/agents/**`, embedded into the binary via `include_str!` and single-sourced from the repo. Today: `codebase-navigator`, `spec-writer`, `plan-writer`, `spec-review`, `plan-review`, `agent-builder` — and, after this change, `implementation-phase-reviewer`, so the set grows six to seven. Membership is decided by repo-agnosticism: a distributed agent carries no repo-specific build grant and does not need the repo's paths, gates, or edit scopes. Distributed agents do NOT carry the agent-builder's `generated: true` marker (that marker distinguishes agent-builder output from the distributed core). The `implementation-phase-reviewer` moves here from the generated set.
